head: 012a3d997eec713166365eb77a466008f732d642
task: Version 1: token-bounded requests with a fill report, backend retries, a thread list, media in answers, a sandboxed workspace and an explicit refusal for unreadable attachments
result: All five items implemented and verified live. ModelBackend gained context_limit(), read from /v1/models; fold_older_messages gained a token trigger fed by usage.prompt_tokens; Agent gained budget()/fill(); MemoryStore gained a Thread overview; the Chainlit app gained a conversation chooser, media elements, a fill report and a refusal notice; AGENT_WORKSPACE now defaults to a workspace/ sandbox. The live run found a real defect the unit tests missed: a short conversation over budget passed a negative start to first_user_turn, which Python read as an index from the end - IndexError inside the graph. first_user_turn now clamps it, with three regression tests. An httpx timeout also stringified to nothing, so the unreachable-endpoint message now names the endpoint and the exception class. ROADMAP closes Stage 3; README and chainlit.md updated; evidence in reports/2026-08-01_v1.md.
checks: python -m pytest -q: 188 passed; uvx ruff check on every touched file: clean (5 repository findings are pre-existing in scripts/doctor.py, tests/test_doctor.py, tests/test_work_log.py); python -m scripts.v1_live against vLLM: all four sections passed
